Renamed `totalAmount` → `grossAmount` across all five hand-written sources:

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `api/src/main/java/mn/shop/api/Order.java:15,27` | entity field + `getTotalAmount()` → `getGrossAmount()` |
| `api/src/main/java/mn/shop/api/OrderDto.java:5,8` | record component + the accessor call in `of()` |
| `api/src/main/resources/graphql/order.graphqls:4` | schema field |
| `web/src/lib/orders.ts:6,25` | `ORDERS_QUERY` selection set + `Order` interface |
| `web/src/components/OrderSummary.tsx:4,12` | the `reduce` and the rendered cell |

Verified: `mvn -o test` passes after a forced recompile (`Compiling 4 source files`, 1 test green), and `tsc --noEmit` plus `vitest run` are clean. The GraphQL schema field and the client query moved together, so the wire contract stays consistent.

Two things I deliberately left alone, and one thing you should decide on:

- **`web/src/generated/graphql-generated.ts:11` still says `totalAmount`.** Its header says it's regenerated from `order.graphqls` on every build and must not be hand-edited, and nothing in `web/src` imports it — the components use the hand-written `Order` in `lib/orders.ts`. There's no codegen script in `web/package.json` (only `build`/`test`), so I couldn't regenerate it. It'll pick up the new name the next time codegen actually runs; hand-patching it would just have created a fake-clean diff.
- **`web/src/lib/orders.test.ts:9` mentions `totalAmount` in a doc comment** explaining why the test asserts on transport rather than field names. It's prose about the rename, not a reference to the field, so renaming it would make the comment read oddly.

Worth your attention: `Order` is a JPA `@Entity` with no `@Column` annotation, so the column name comes from the field via the implicit naming strategy — this rename moves it from `total_amount` to `gross_amount`. There are no migrations in the repo (no Flyway/Liquibase dir, no `schema.sql`), so I couldn't carry the database half of the rename. If the underlying table still has `total_amount`, either add a migration or pin the old column with `@Column(name = "total_amount")` on the renamed field. Tell me which you want and I'll do it.
